name: zapier
description: Zapier MCP — GA, agentic or managed servers that run actions against your existing app connections

requirements: A named MCP client — one server is created per client
App connections already set up in the Zapier account
notes: General availability; available on Team and Enterprise plans.
One server per named MCP client; sharing a server needs Team or Enterprise.
Streamable HTTP only — SSE is NOT supported.
Agentic mode (default) exposes the fixed meta-tools discover_zapier_actions, enable_zapier_action, manage_zapier_connections, auto_provision_mcp.
Managed mode exposes one tool per action, configured in Zapier.
Actions run against the user's existing app connections and CAN mutate those apps.
Tool calls consume Zapier tasks from the plan quota; failed calls are free.
SOC 2 Type II. Enablement is account-level, controls are workspace-level, and task quotas are per workspace.
